chapterInfo.content:
6
Hiob su n’awerɛhoɔ, na ɔkasa tia ne nnamfo no denyɛ
1Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:
2O, sɛ anka wɔrekari m’awerɛhoɔ,
na wɔde me yea nso agu nsania mu susu ɛ!
3Ɛno deɛ anka ɛbɛsene mpoano anwea duru,
enti na me nsɛm ayɛ hatuhatu yi,
4 # Dwom 38.2 na Otumfoɔ agyan tuatua me mu,
me honhom renom emu borɔ,
Nyankopɔn ahuyideɛ atwa me ho mpasua.
5Ɔtorɔmo nya ɛserɛ mono a, ɔteateam?
Anaa ɔnantwie su n’aduane ho?
6Wɔdi aduane hunu a nkyene nni mu?
Ɛdɛ bi wɔ kosua mu fufuo mu?
7Adeɛ a me kra ampɛ sɛ ɛbɛka me no,
ɛno ara na ayɛ me aduane a ɛyɛ me nwunu.
8O, sɛ anka merenya m’abisadeɛ,
na Onyankopɔn ama me m’anigyinadeɛ no ɛ!
9Sɛ Onyankopɔn pene na ɔpɛkyɛ me,
na ɔgya ne nsa kwan na ɛtwa me ɛ!
10Anka ɛbɛyɛ me awerɛkyekyerɛ ara na madi ahurisie,
ɛyea a ɛnni adɔna me soɔ no mu,
ɛfiri sɛ mensane Ɔkronkronni no nsɛm no!
11M’ahoɔden ne deɛn, sɛ mede bɛtɔ me bo aseɛ,
na m’awieeɛ ne deɛn, sɛ me kra bɛkyɛre ho?
12M’ahoɔden yɛ aboɔ ahoɔden,
me honam yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ?
13Ɛnyɛ mmoa bi na ɛnni me mu,
na wɔatu ahoɔden afiri me ho?
14Deɛ ne home te no no, ɛsɛ no ne yɔnko nsam adɔeɛ;
anyɛ saa a, ɔgyaa Otumfoɔ no suro.
15 # Dwom 38.11 Me nuanom twa nkontompo sɛ asusɔsuwa,
sɛ subonhwa a emu nsuwansuwa resene korɔ.
16Nsukyeneeɛ nti ani fono,
sukyerɛmma hyɛne mu hunta.
17Sɛ hyehyeɛ ka no a, ɛtwitwa,
ahuhuro mu ɛyera firi n’afa.
18N’akwantemfoɔ no kwan kontonkonton,
ɛdane huruhuro kɔ soro na ɛyera.
19 # Gye 25.15; Hiob 1.15 Tema akwantemfoɔ asafo no hwɛe,
Seba anantefoɔ ani daa so,
20wɔn ani wuu sɛ wɔde wɔn ani too soɔ,
wɔkɔduruu ho, na wɔn anim guu ase.
21Na afei saa ara na mo nso moteɛ,
moahunu m’amanehunu yi, moannya tema biara amma me.
22Maka sɛ mommrɛ me biribi,
na me nti momfa mo adeɛ bi nkyɛ,
23na monyi me ɔhohiahiafoɔ nsam,
na monnye me mfiri nhyɛsofoɔ nsam anaa?
24Monkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mɛyɛ komm,
na deɛ mafom wɔ mu no, momma menhunu.
25Sɛdeɛ atɛntenenee si yɛ den fa!
Na mo atɛnyie yi deɛ, animka bɛn na ɛwɔ mu?
26Nsɛm ho animka na modwene?
Ɔwerɛhoni deɛ, ne nsɛm yɛ mframa.
27Awisiaa so mpo moretwe ntonto,
na mo yɔnko tiri nso moredi ano.
28Na afei mompɛ ani pa nhwɛ me,
na merenni torɔ mo anim ha.
29Mompɛ mu bio ɛ, na mommmu ntɛnkyea;
na monsane mpɛ mu, na m’asɛm wom ara.
30Deɛ ɛntene bi wɔ me tɛkyerɛma so,
anaasɛ me dodom nhunu abusudeɛ?

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:
O, sɛ anka wɔrekari m’awerɛhoɔ,
na wɔde me yea nso agu nsania mu susu ɛ!
Ɛno deɛ anka ɛbɛsene mpoano anwea duru,
enti na me nsɛm ayɛ hatuhatu yi,
na Otumfoɔ agyan tuatua me mu,
me honhom renom emu borɔ,
Nyankopɔn ahuyideɛ atwa me ho mpasua.
Ɔtorɔmo nya ɛserɛ mono a, ɔteateam?
Anaa ɔnantwie su n’aduane ho?
Wɔdi aduane hunu a nkyene nni mu?
Ɛdɛ bi wɔ kosua mu fufuo mu?
Adeɛ a me kra ampɛ sɛ ɛbɛka me no,
ɛno ara na ayɛ me aduane a ɛyɛ me nwunu.

O, sɛ anka merenya m’abisadeɛ,
na Onyankopɔn ama me m’anigyinadeɛ no ɛ!
Sɛ Onyankopɔn pene na ɔpɛkyɛ me,
na ɔgya ne nsa kwan na ɛtwa me ɛ!
Anka ɛbɛyɛ me awerɛkyekyerɛ ara na madi ahurisie,
ɛyea a ɛnni adɔna me soɔ no mu,
ɛfiri sɛ mensane Ɔkronkronni no nsɛm no!
M’ahoɔden ne deɛn, sɛ mede bɛtɔ me bo aseɛ,
na m’awieeɛ ne deɛn, sɛ me kra bɛkyɛre ho?
M’ahoɔden yɛ aboɔ ahoɔden,
me honam yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ?
Ɛnyɛ mmoa bi na ɛnni me mu,
na wɔatu ahoɔden afiri me ho?

Deɛ ne home te no no, ɛsɛ no ne yɔnko nsam adɔeɛ;
anyɛ saa a, ɔgyaa Otumfoɔ no suro.
Me nuanom twa nkontompo sɛ asusɔsuwa,
sɛ subonhwa a emu nsuwansuwa resene korɔ.
Nsukyeneeɛ nti ani fono,
sukyerɛmma hyɛne mu hunta.
Sɛ hyehyeɛ ka no a, ɛtwitwa,
ahuhuro mu ɛyera firi n’afa.
N’akwantemfoɔ no kwan kontonkonton,
ɛdane huruhuro kɔ soro na ɛyera.
Tema akwantemfoɔ asafo no hwɛe,
Seba anantefoɔ ani daa so,
wɔn ani wuu sɛ wɔde wɔn ani too soɔ,
wɔkɔduruu ho, na wɔn anim guu ase.
Na afei saa ara na mo nso moteɛ,
moahunu m’amanehunu yi, moannya tema biara amma me.
Maka sɛ mommrɛ me biribi,
na me nti momfa mo adeɛ bi nkyɛ,
na monyi me ɔhohiahiafoɔ nsam,
na monnye me mfiri nhyɛsofoɔ nsam anaa?

Monkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mɛyɛ komm,
na deɛ mafom wɔ mu no, momma menhunu.
Sɛdeɛ atɛntenenee si yɛ den fa!
Na mo atɛnyie yi deɛ, animka bɛn na ɛwɔ mu?
Nsɛm ho animka na modwene?
Ɔwerɛhoni deɛ, ne nsɛm yɛ mframa.
Awisiaa so mpo moretwe ntonto,
na mo yɔnko tiri nso moredi ano.
Na afei mompɛ ani pa nhwɛ me,
na merenni torɔ mo anim ha.
Mompɛ mu bio ɛ, na mommmu ntɛnkyea;
na monsane mpɛ mu, na m’asɛm wom ara.
Deɛ ɛntene bi wɔ me tɛkyerɛma so,
anaasɛ me dodom nhunu abusudeɛ?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
